amazon._note: Client decision 1 Oct 2026 (Ralph): Amazon marketplace customers (Gutster / Staple Popper / Duckbill Amazon USA and Canada) get their own Revenue Detail source ('Amazon Invoice' / 'Amazon Sales Order') and Cash Flow Model row 10 (1100.3 Amazon), like SERVPRO; they are no longer in A/R Collection (row 14). Assumptions & Rules row 7.

invoices.receipt_week: Friday on or after due date; due before week 1 -> week 1

sales_orders.amount_basis: uninvoiced remainder = total - invoiced (draft invoices count as invoiced)
sales_orders.no_ship_date_rule: order date + terms days, labelled UNVERIFIED
sales_orders.receipt_week: Friday on or after cash-in date; before week 1 -> week 1

parent_orders._note: A parent order whose partial fills were raised under their own SO numbers: forecast only the parent's remainder = parent total less the fills (their invoices in Zoho; fallback amounts if the invoices are not in the pull). Applied only while the parent total is at least the fills; once Zoho has reduced the parent itself (e.g. SO-05927 now $61.75), it is forecast as it stands.

SO-05927.reason: SERVPRO 333K coverall order re-entered as SO-05927; SO-05859 (724 u) and SO-05919 (1,221 u) are partial fills already invoiced.

purchase_orders.due_date_rule: delivery date (or PO date when no delivery date, UNVERIFIED) + Zoho supplier Payment Terms days (Net 30/60/90; Due on Receipt = 0), per Assumptions & Rules row 12 'Supplier terms'. Applies whether or not goods are received.
purchase_orders.payment_week: Friday on or before due date; overdue -> week 1

bills.payment_week: Friday on or before due date; overdue -> week 1
